visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a montage of a young woman with long blonde hair and glasses. She is seen in several quick cuts wearing different outfits: a white oversized t-shirt, a red plaid maid-style costume with a headband, a school-style uniform with a grey tie, and a blue floral cheongsam. She performs small dance movements and hand gestures toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor room with a grey door in the background. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting at a desk equipped with a dual-monitor setup, a white mechanical keyboard, and purple-tinted ambient lighting. She wears a grey and white school uniform with large white over-ear headphones. She holds a white computer mouse close to her face and smiles brightly. (3) Several extreme close-up shots show a white computer mouse with an ROG logo. The woman's hands are seen tossing the mouse lightly in the air to demonstrate its weight. The lighting remains bright, highlighting the texture of the white plastic. (4) Close-up shots show the mouse being used on a dark grey desk mat. A computer screen in the background displays a tactical first-person shooter game with various UI elements. The camera pans over the mouse and the woman's hand as she maneuvers it precisely. (5) Technical close-ups focus on the underside of the mouse, showing its sensor and buttons. Hands are seen plugging a white USB cable and a small grey wireless dongle into a computer port. (6) On-screen footage transitions to a screen recording of a first-person shooter game. Overlaid graphics show a gauge moving rapidly. The woman is seen in the corner of the frame, wearing her headphones and focused on the screen while moving the mouse. (7) Macro shots detail the mouse buttons being pressed. The internal RGB lighting of the mouse scrolls through colors, specifically purple and red. The woman holds the mouse against her cheek, smiling with her eyes closed, then points to the mouse's light. (8) The final sequence shows a screen recording of the ROG Gear Link web interface with various slider controls and settings. The woman performs a celebratory dance in her chair, giving a thumbs up and a peace sign as she presents the mouse to the camera one last time.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo electronic pop music with female vocals singing 'I like my beats fast'. The beat is driving and synthesized with bright spectral weight. (2) A cheerful female narrator enters with a high-pitched, enthusiastic greeting. The BGM ducks in volume to accommodate the voice track. (3) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the narrator begins describing a gaming product. The vocal delivery is fast and energetic. (4) A subtle thud sound effect occurs as the physical weight of the mouse is mentioned. The music maintains a constant 128 BPM pulse. (5) A series of digital UI 'dings' and sparkle-like sound effects accompany the description of technical specifications like DPI and sensors. (6) A sharp, metallic click sound effect is introduced as the wireless dongle is mentioned, punctuating the narrative. (7) High-frequency percussive clicking sounds (simulating mouse switches) are layered prominently as the narrator discusses switch durability. (8) The narrator’s tone becomes more persuasive and final as she delivers the call to action. A final digital transition SFX concludes the audio track as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the ROG Keris II Origin gaming mouse by highlighting its lightweight design, technical performance specs, and customizability through an energetic presentation by a popular female creator.
